rows.result: World model beats persistence and LR at every horizon (PR-AUC 0.077 / 0.071 / 0.079).
With the 10-window history randomly permuted, PR-AUC drops to 0.006 / 0.011 / 0.014 — the model reads temporal dynamics, not a static host fingerprint.
Zeroing the 9 packet-derived features gives PR-AUC 0.001 / 0.002 / 0.003 vs 0.077 / 0.071 / 0.079 with them.
Trained with Infiltration excluded; tested only on it (positives [3, 5, 7]): PR-AUC 0.049 / 0.067 / 0.101.
